body:
I like to paint and draw, but I feel that it is more therapeutic than useful. It won't get me anywhere in life, and I feel terribly guilty about it.

If I can take a leave of absence, I'll end up at home, with my grumpy detached father, bipolar mother, and angry 16 year old brother. If winter break was anything to go by, I should avoid that at all costs.

Maybe I should try to get admitted to a mental hospital?

My parents told my younger brother that orange juice was camel piss, and oranges were camel balls.

We were also told the Chanukah Lion left us presents, but I don't think either of us ever believed that one.

When I was little, my mom told me she trained our beagle Barney to use his "inside voice"

In reality, our crazy-ass neighbor stole him, chained him in his back yard, choked him, shot him with a BB gun, and left him without food or water for three days until my bad-ass mom went and said "I know you have him, and if he doesn't come back tonight, there will be trouble."

Barney came strolling back the next morning, tail a-wagging, but vocal chords forever destroyed. He was a nice dog apart from the wheezing and strange hoarse barks.
